metadata.description: Claude Crew (a live view of Claude and its helpers at work) and Codex Bridge (OpenAI Codex as a Claude subagent).

plugins.name: crew-map
plugins.description: A live view of what Claude and its helper Claudes are doing: a desk per Claude with what it is on now, folder cards of the files touched and changed, a window per Claude with goal, progress, cost and context, waiting-on-you alerts, running commands and tests, build errors, replay and a task summary. An optional tree map too.

plugins.name: codex-bridge
plugins.description: Gives Claude a codex tool: hand a task to OpenAI Codex (your own ChatGPT/Codex subscription) as a subagent, with model and effort choice, per-project memory, named threads you can rename, reset and archive, your plan usage at a glance, and a live pane of what Codex is doing.
